patterns.note: Full-bleed, edge-to-edge imagery is consistently used for hero sections and product displays, creating an immersive visual experience.
Product display sections utilize a dynamic, irregular grid of full-bleed images, allowing for varied aspect ratios to create a gallery-like mosaic.
Prominent use of large, bold, uppercase sans-serif typography for section titles and calls to action, creating strong visual hierarchy and impact.
A stark black and white base palette dominates the UI, allowing rich product photography to introduce the primary color and visual interest.
The hero section features descriptive text and a call-to-action button that remain fixed in the viewport while a large background image scrolls underneath, creating a subtle parallax effect.
The homepage structure alternates between large, full-bleed photographic sections and more text-focused promotional blocks, maintaining visual interest and flow.

technique_notes: A fixed header bar is used for the logo and minimal navigation elements, ensuring they are always accessible at the top of the viewport.

The hero section combines a large, vertically scrolling background image with absolutely positioned text and a call-to-action button that remain fixed relative to the viewport, giving the impression of the background image moving behind the text.

Product galleries are constructed using a flexible grid system that allows images of varying aspect ratios to fill the available width, creating a visually rich, full-bleed mosaic without explicit gutters.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold, uppercase sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) are used for impact, with body text and descriptions in a smaller, lighter weight sans-serif.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with generous vertical padding between major content blocks and a balanced density within text blocks.

standout: The site's distinctive use of full-bleed, high-quality editorial photography, particularly in the split-screen hero and the dynamic product grid, creates a luxurious and immersive visual experience that feels more like a fashion magazine than a typical e-commerce site. The minimal UI allows the product imagery to be the absolute focal point.
